:::{#def-affine-function}
#### Affine function of one variable

A [function](sets-functions.qmd#def-function) $f: \reals \to \reals$
is **affine** if there are numbers $m$ and $b$ such that

$$f(x) = m x + b \quad \text{for all } x \in \reals$$

In this formula, $m$ is called the **slope** of $f$
and $b$ its **intercept**.

:::
